rule: Gate (a) of the structure check, for the (heap, kinds) of this
entry: the closure total U = objSize((D, [simpLib, Traverse,
Travrules, Opening, boolSimps, pureSimps])), D being
ThmAttribute and Cond_rewr (structure and signature) and
Context.snapshot (), changes from base to candidate by exactly
`value` words. Gate (b): no structure's exclusive part
objSize((D, X)) - objSize((D, D)) grows (candidate <= base).
Every (heap, kind) whose registry record computes U must be
covered by exactly one entry. The `ext` probe (explicit
extension use, candidate only) is excluded from this gate: its
U less the ordinary candidate's and its exclusive parts are an
E2 reported row (`E2:u`), not an S2 decision.
mechanism: Only D's own code and type structure grow; no state and nothing
per object. ThmAttribute: two more closures in the structure
record (attribute_fns_of and attribute_fns, read-only Map.lookup
of funstore_of; the second calls Context.snapshot) and two more
val specs in the signature (Context.t -> string -> attrfuns
option, string -> attrfuns option); alone +870 words (struct)
Cond_rewr: the structure source is byte-identical, but the
structure is opaquely ascribed (:>), so the new spec
note_rewrite : thm -> unit exports one more slot: the closure of
note_rewrite (defined at Cond_rewr.sml:27, applied inside the
structure) now hangs from the structure record; alone +357
words (struct) and +91 (sig, one spec). D as a whole grows by
+1125 words, less than the +1908 of its four parts, because they
share types and constants. The total grows by +754 rather than
+1125 because 371 words of what D now reaches were already in the
total through simpLib and Traverse, whose exclusive parts shrink
(-368 and -363 words; Travrules -12, boolSimps -6, Opening and
pureSimps 0). Observed in two processes per side for each of
the two kinds, three repeats each, all equal (and equal across
the kinds: one image). Scope: only the hol.state kinds
state-empty and first-use compute U. On hol.state0
(state0-empty, load-simpLib, load-congLib) boolSimps and
pureSimps are not loaded, so U is null (and D itself is absent
at state0-empty); nothing is declared for them, and their
per-structure parts are reported only.

rule: Compared: the L3 lists (listeners, attributes, set types,
structures, signatures, functors) of the `ext` process, after
explicit extension use, against the ordinary candidate's
registry-state-empty on the same heap. Per list the names the
extension processes add are among the `registers` of the
observable extension_state entries or of probe_support; every name
of a `required` entry is added; no ordinary name is removed; the
ordinary listeners keep their relative order; every ext process
agrees. `loaded` and `files` are not compared (the probe modules
differ by design). State that is not observable in these lists
(`observable: false`) satisfies nothing.

justification: Added by the ext probe's own graph work, not by the extension:
T33GraphLib (the probe module) and RuntimeMetrics (its helper)
are defined in the probe directory, and congLib, an ordinary
library of both sides, is loaded by the probe's code anchor
(congLib.mk_congset). Live registry runs of the ext probe and of
registry-state-empty on the candidate (hol.state) differ in these
and in the extension modules only.
